notes.title: 20% off!!English version update!
notes.notes:
20% off for half a month！

The current update will fix the following to the new English version of this game:
+ Fixed the bug of any incomplete English translations
+ Fixed the animation of the Live 2D program that causes a few of the dialogue interface to result in a white screen.
+ Added the option to turn the hints on/off.
+ Skipping Mini Games

In this current update we have also asked @Teleute_Eirene to edit our dialogues, descriptions of collections, character introductions and other English translations to give you a better translated story. 

In the next update, we will be replacing all the translated text in the images to that done by @Teleute_Eirene. So please look forward to it.:aboutlove:

notes.title: English update
notes.notes:
【Enabling Hints】
If checked,importantcluesin the game willshimmerone by one to give you hints. (Collectibles and clues for secondary events will not shimmer.)

【Skipping Mini Games】
Five seconds after a mini game starts, a skip button will appear in the bottom left corner (not all mini games can be skipped).

 Thank you for your support.:aboutlove:
